statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-33997 is a privilege-validation bypass in the Moby daemon's plugin installation. The module ships only inside the container plugin's Go worker (libcontainer.so). Checked with `go list -deps -tags containers_image_openpgp .` on plugins/container v0.7.5 go-worker after this recipe's floats (2026-10-19): it links github.com/docker/docker/client, api and api/types/* only, and from the new module paths moby/moby/api types and moby/moby/client; no daemon, plugin, api/server or pkg/authorization package of either path. The recipe fails the build if one is ever linked. The fix (29.3.1) exists only under the moby/moby module path, so the +incompatible module cannot be floated to it.
